posts.text: Can someone please help me understand why the discrepency: The documents submitted in Parivesh (EC) talk about capacity of 1.6 GW of Solar Cells and 1.2 GW of Solar Modules only, while all Alpex investor disclosures mention 2.2 GW of TopCon Cells capacity. The chronology as per my understanding: Oct 2024: Alpex originally announced a 1.6 GW solar-cell project at Plot A-2/2, Kosi Kotwan. 29 Oct 2025: the Board formally upgraded that same Kosi Kotwan cell facility from 1.6 GW to 2.2 GW , initially 1.4 GW + 0.8 GW.
